positioning.buyer: Claire Dumas — CTO / Head of AI Platform
positioning.decision: Distinguish what was built, what is publicly inspectable, what is contribution-level, and what remains NDA-bound before an agentic-AI engagement.

copy_sequences.buyer_question: What am I being asked to believe about this portfolio?
What can I verify here before considering an engagement?
copy_sequences.copy: Four bounded implementation records answer the production-side hiring question: what has been built, what can be inspected publicly, and where the strongest governed-agent work remains NDA-bound.

support.boundary: Count and scope of records only; no external outcome inference.

copy_sequences.buyer_question: Is this proof relevant to my production problem?
copy_sequences.copy: Relevant when a CTO / Head of AI Platform needs existing-stack fit, explicit tool and data authority, evaluation gates, governed memory, runtime traces and a handoff path before expanding an agentic system.

copy_sequences.buyer_question: What did Mickael contribute, and what must not be over-attributed?
copy_sequences.copy: The record attributes Mickael's contribution at artifact level rather than claiming the whole collaborative repository. Big Five/IPIP, JSON, Mistral and LangChain were used to test persona consistency, constrained responses and bias.

support.boundary: Repository ownership is not whole-project authorship; attribution remains contribution-level.

copy_sequences.buyer_question: Which RAG/tooling components were implemented, and what does that evidence not prove?
copy_sequences.copy: The public registry covers a Solidity Code Tutor RAG prototype, a LangChain router and a Scrapy crawler, with flattened-history limits preserved. Implementation scope includes retrieval, routing and crawling; no public production Recall@K, latency or ROI claim is made.

support.boundary: Some imported private history is flattened; commit history is not a proxy for production quality.

copy_sequences.buyer_question: Is there a small original LLM application with delivery tooling I can inspect?
copy_sequences.copy: This non-fork prototype demonstrates a bounded LLM interface, Docker packaging and GitLab CI; it is not presented as production reliability or ROI evidence.

support.boundary: Prototype proof is not production reliability, security or ROI evidence.

copy_sequences.buyer_question: What governed-agent work can be described without breaching NDA?
copy_sequences.copy: The public capability boundary covers agent registries, permissions, governed memory, human review, evaluation and execution observability. The strongest governed-operations work remains NDA-bound; no private production metric is exposed here.

support.boundary: Responsibilities and architecture only; no private code, client, production metric or deployment topology.

copy_sequences.buyer_question: Should evaluation be designed around the context of the actual agentic system?
copy_sequences.copy: NIST's current public TEVV-Athlon draft uses a four-stage method for context-specific AI assessments and explicitly includes agentic systems in scope.
copy_sequences.boundary: Official draft methodology; it does not prescribe this consulting offer or prove a business outcome.

copy_sequences.buyer_question: Which operational controls become relevant as agent autonomy increases?
copy_sequences.copy: NCSC's 20 August 2026 interim agentic-AI guidance is organized around seven operational considerations, including threat modelling, oversight, sandboxing, observability, attribution and emergency shutdown.
copy_sequences.boundary: Interim NCSC practical guidance; formal guidance is still being developed.

copy_sequences.buyer_question: Is there controlled evidence that moving authorization outside the model can materially change an exfiltration result?
copy_sequences.copy: In the paper's compromised-model evaluation, external authorization reduced observed AgentDojo exfiltration to 0% across every reported exfiltration category.
copy_sequences.boundary: Preprint/benchmark-protocol result; not universal prevention of prompt injection, not evidence of Mickael's NDA implementation, and not a production security guarantee.

copy_sequences.buyer_question: How do I know repository ownership is not being used as a proxy for authorship?
copy_sequences.copy: Repository ownership is not authorship. The proof layer separates creation, substantial contribution, artifact-level attribution and NDA-bounded capability, while preserving known gaps in commit history.

copy_sequences.buyer_question: Can I apply the same framing to my own system before a commercial call?
copy_sequences.copy: Use the same proof-first frame on your own system. The framework is published and free; choose the problem you are working on and receive the relevant version rather than a generic catalogue.

EU-AGENTIC-NIST-TEVV-4-STAGES-2026.boundary: Official draft method; not consulting-effect evidence.

EU-CANON-BOUNDED-AGENTS-EXFIL-2026.effect: AgentDojo exfiltration 75–100% without defense to 0% with external authorization in reported categories
EU-CANON-BOUNDED-AGENTS-EXFIL-2026.boundary: Protocol-bounded benchmark; no universal production-security claim.
